description:
Gabby Thomas explains why the best athlete-brand relationships go beyond a campaign.

On this week’s episode of A Different Take with Linda Boff, the Olympic champion breaks down the difference between an endorsement and a true partnership—and why building with a brand can create something more meaningful over time.

A Different Take is a marketing case study podcast that unpacks the strategy behind one iconic brand each season. This season explores how New Balance evolved into a major force in sports and culture.

Watch the full episode on the Forbes YouTube channel.
title: Olympian Gabby Thomas On What Makes A Brand Partnership Feel Real
